summary: Links the named control and measurement points to the selected resource communication model.
description: Links the named control and measurement points to the selected resource communication model. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Resource point definitions” at the input and “Mapped site-control data” at the output. Units and sign conventions must be preserved.
